newsitem.title: SWEDEN: P&U might merge Biotech with Amersham - paper.
newsitem.headline: P&U might merge Biotech with Amersham - paper.

text.p: Swedish-U.S. drugs group Pharmacia & Upjohn is negotiating about merging its subsidiary Biotech with British group Amersham, daily Dagens Industri reported on Friday.
Sources told the newspaper that Amersham was in Uppsala, Sweden, two weeks ago and conducted due diligence.
"Pharmacia & Upjohn has previously said it does not want to sell all of Biotech but keep an influence over the company and thereby access to its operations," Dagens Industri said.
"This (suggests)...negotiations between the two companies will lead to a merger," it said.
Pharmacia & Upjohn did not want to comment.
"We don't give any comments during ongoing processes," Arne Forsell, the president of Pharmacia Biotech, told the newspaper.
"But we hope to be able to make an announcement before the end of June," he was quoted as saying.
The companies would have a combined market capitalisation of about 15 billion crowns, the newspaper said.
Biotech develops instruments for biotechnology research and Amersham develops and sells specially designed research products and diagnostic instruments, the newspaper said.
Biotech has annual sales of more than three billion crowns, while Amersham's sales amount to more than four billion crowns, the daily said.
